segments.text: You are going to listen to a conversation between a student and an advisor about a language course.
First, you have some time to look at questions 1 to 5.
Now listen carefully and answer questions 1 to 5.
Good morning, UE Information Centre. How can I help you?
Good morning. I'd like some information about academic support classes, please.
I'm new to the university and I don't think my study skills are strong enough.
Sure, we offer tutoring to help first years, especially international students,
improve their academic skills for their university life.
Are there any particular skills you want to improve?
Well, a lot actually.
I'm having trouble with textbooks and materials.
It's not that I don't understand what they say,
but it takes me longer to finish a chapter than my native speaking friends.
Ah yes, we do have academic reading classes. They will help you read more efficiently.
Great! Also, I'm struggling with all the presentations. I have no problem creating
content, but speaking in front of an audience always makes me nervous.
We have classes on how to make good slides for your presentation,
but I'm afraid we don't have soft skills classes.
Maybe you can ask your friends to help you practice.
That will make you more confident.
That's a great idea, thanks.
One more problem.
I'm not good at writing research papers either, to be honest.
This is a common problem for international students.
The academic writing class is exactly what you need.
Lovely.
When do the classes begin?
Well, the reading class takes place every Tuesday,
from 4 to 5.30pm. Oh no sorry, that was last term. This term it is on Wednesdays at the same time.
And the writing class is on Mondays from 1 to 3pm. Both classes start next week.
Great, they don't clash with my schedule. Where do the sessions take place?
Oh sorry, I forgot to mention that. There aren't usually many students who sign up for
the reading class, so it will take place in Block Q, Room 401. The writing class, however,
is very popular, so only the lecture hall in Block B can fit everyone.
Thank you. And how about the tuition fee? How much do I need to pay for each class?
They are free for UE students. There will be some materials you might want to purchase,
but they are optional, since you can borrow them from the library. I recommend buying them because
the number of students often exceeds the number of copies in the library. They're not expensive,
just under £30, I believe. Oh, okay. I'll consider it. Thank you very much.
Before you listen to the rest of the conversation, you will have some time to look at questions
six to ten. Now listen carefully and answer questions six to ten. Oh, how can I register
for the classes? You can log on to the Blackboard and follow the steps online or I can fill in a
paper form for you right now. Yes please, I haven't got used to the website yet. All right,
Could you tell me your name please?
Yes, it's Marcus Lopez.
Is it L-O-P-E-Z?
No, it's an S, not a Z.
Alright, now what is your student number?
Is it on my student card?
Yes, it should be under your photo on your student card.
Oh, here it is. Two, zero, two, seven, zero, five, one, nine.
Okay, have you got a UK phone number yet?
Yes, I got one yesterday. Let me see. Here you go.
Oh, seven, five, nine, eight, two, oh, eight, one, eight, six.
Where do you live? I'm in your current address.
Ah, now this I remember. Number 25 4th Avenue, Filton. The postcode is BS70RN.
Alright, everything's done. You are now enlisted in the classes. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, thank you very much. Have a nice day.
You are welcome.
That's the end of part one. Now you have 30 seconds to check your answers.
